import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Convert 'survived' column to categorical for better visualization
df['survived'] = pd.Categorical(df['survived'])

# Create a bar chart to compare survival rate by sex
sns.set()
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.barplot(x='sex', y='survived', data=df)
plt.title('Survival Rate by Sex')
plt.xlabel('Sex')
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram to show the distribution of age
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.histplot(df['age'], kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Passenger Age')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_age_dist.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a box plot to compare fare by class
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.boxplot(x='pclass', y='fare', data=df)
plt.title('Fare Distribution by Class')
plt.xlabel('Class')
plt.ylabel('Fare')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_fare_class.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
